description: This file implements the Administrator class within the WPEFramework RPC namespace, managing proxies, stubs, and interface registration for inter-process communication. It includes methods for reference counting, proxy creation, interface validation, and channel management.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, and interface registration for IPC channels within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: ~Administrator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up proxies and stubs.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Administrator.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for an interface implementation.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and releases interface.

methods.name: UnregisterUnknownProxy
methods.description: Removes a proxy from internal maps.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles invocation of methods on a given interface.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates if an implementation instance is valid for a given interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy for a given channel, implementation, and interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel and implementation.

methods.name: RegisterUnknownInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface pointer with a channel and interface ID.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a raw implementation pointer to an IUnknown interface.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Removes all proxies and references associated with a channel.
